title: Detailed tractor
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- big rear wheel -->
    <circle cx='68' cy='70' r='21' fill='#8a1c1c'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='70' r='21' fill='none' stroke='#ff5a4a' stroke-width='3'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='70' r='13' fill='#c9c9d8'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='70' r='6' fill='#ffd23f'/>
    <g stroke='#ff5a4a' stroke-width='2.5'>
      <line x1='68' y1='50' x2='68' y2='90'/>
      <line x1='48' y1='70' x2='88' y2='70'/>
      <line x1='54' y1='56' x2='82' y2='84'/>
      <line x1='82' y1='56' x2='54' y2='84'/>
    </g>
    <!-- small front wheel -->
    <circle cx='22' cy='78' r='13' fill='#8a1c1c'/>
    <circle cx='22' cy='78' r='13' fill='none' stroke='#ff5a4a' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    <circle cx='22' cy='78' r='7' fill='#c9c9d8'/>
    <circle cx='22' cy='78' r='3' fill='#ffd23f'/>
    <!-- chassis -->
    <rect x='14' y='62' width='60' height='9' rx='3' fill='#3a4a2a'/>
    <!-- engine hood -->
    <rect x='30' y='40' width='42' height='22' rx='5' fill='#3f8a2a'/>
    <rect x='30' y='40' width='42' height='6' rx='3' fill='#7ae04a'/>
    <!-- grille -->
    <rect x='33' y='52' width='14' height='8' rx='2' fill='#ffd23f'/>
    <g stroke='#3a4a2a' stroke-width='1.5'>
      <line x1='37' y1='52' x2='37' y2='60'/>
      <line x1='41' y1='52' x2='41' y2='60'/>
      <line x1='45' y1='52' x2='45' y2='60'/>
    </g>
    <!-- exhaust pipe -->
    <rect x='66' y='30' width='5' height='16' rx='2' fill='#c9c9d8'/>
    <rect x='66' y='28' width='5' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ff5a4a'/>
    <!-- cabin -->
    <rect x='50' y='14' width='26' height='28' rx='4' fill='#4aa8ff'/>
    <rect x='53' y='18' width='20' height='13' rx='2' fill='#c9eaff'/>
    <rect x='53' y='34' width='20' height='5' rx='2' fill='#2a6aa8'/>
    <!-- cabin roof light -->
    <rect x='60' y='9' width='6' height='5' rx='2' fill='#ffd23f'/>
    <!-- fender over big wheel -->
    <path d='M44 56 Q68 34 92 56' fill='none' stroke='#7ae04a' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- steering wheel hint / headlight -->
    <circle cx='36' cy='47' r='3' fill='#fff7b0'/>
  </g>
</svg>
